sections.text_helper: Section 19.4.19 "XSPI reconfiguration or deactivation" in chapter 19 (Extended-SPI interface (XSPI)), RM0522 Rev 1, page 524.
sections.section_content:
Before any XSPI reconfiguration, the software must ensure that all the transactions are
completed:
• After a memory-mapped write, the software must perform a dummy read followed
byasynchronization barrier, then an abort.
• After a memory-mapped read, the software must perform a synchronization barrier
than an abort.
